sentences.zh: 一辆老旧的白色福特皮卡车从对面驶来，停在了我马路对面。
两个西班牙裔小伙子跳了下来。

sentences.en: an old white Ford pickup going the other direction pulled over across the road from me.
sentences.zh: 其中一个指挥另一个人去路口拐角处

sentences.en: And two Hispanic guys jumped out.
sentences.zh: 减缓交通速度并引导车辆绕过我，因为我当时停在车道中间。

sentences.en: And one of them directed the other one to go up around the corner
sentences.zh: 另一个人穿过马路来到我这边。

sentences.en: of the road to slow traffic down and direct it around me because I was in the middle of the lane.
sentences.zh: 我不记得他说了什么，也不记得我说了什么，

sentences.en: And the other one came across the street.
sentences.zh: 但他只会说几个英语单词。

sentences.en: I don't remember what he said or what I said,
sentences.zh: 他把手放在我的肩膀上。

sentences.en: but he didn't speak more than a couple words of English.
sentences.zh: 我试图告诉他可以走了。

sentences.en: And he put his hand on my shoulder.
sentences.zh: Rick 担心这两个人是非法移民。

sentences.en: And I tried to tell him he could go.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他可能应该离开那里，因为我已经打了911，

sentences.en: Rick worried that the two men were undocumented.
sentences.zh: 高速公路巡警很快就会赶到，他们可能会被盘问或带走。

sentences.en: So I thought he probably should get out of there because I'd called 911 and
highway patrol would be coming and could get questioned or picked up.
sentences.zh: 所以我试图让他放心，我没事，但他根本不听。
他陪我站了大概20分钟，也许吧。

sentences.en: So I tried to reassure him that I was okay, but he would have none of it.

sentences.zh: 但当高速公路巡警出现时，我抬头一看，那个人已经不见了。

sentences.en: And he stood there with me for maybe 20 minutes, maybe.

sentences.zh: 我真希望当时能谢谢他。
是的，我真希望当时能谢谢他。

sentences.en: when the highway patrol showed up, I looked up and this fellow was gone.
